name: 77657 · Lumberton, TX
findings: ZIP 77657 (Lumberton) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77657 (Lumberton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77657 (Lumberton) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).
